+import type { AppDb } from './db'
+import { getDb } from './db'
+import { userId } from './seed'
+import type { AnalyticsSummary, CartTotals, CatalogFilters, PromptCard } from './types'
+
+function dbOrDefault(db?: AppDb) {
+  return db ?? getDb()
+}
+
+export function listCategories(db?: AppDb) {
+  return dbOrDefault(db).prepare('SELECT name FROM categories ORDER BY id').all() as Array<{ name: string }>
+}
+
+export function listPrompts(filters: CatalogFilters = {}, db?: AppDb) {
+  const clauses = ['1 = 1']
+  const params: Record<string, string | number> = { userId }
+  if (filters.model && filters.model !== 'all') {
+    clauses.push('p.model = @model')
+    params.model = filters.model
+  }
+  if (filters.category && filters.category !== 'all') {
+    clauses.push('c.name = @category')
+    params.category = filters.category
+  }
+  if (filters.term) {
+    clauses.push('(LOWER(p.title || " " || p.model || " " || c.name || " " || p.description) LIKE @term)')
+    params.term = `%${filters.term.toLowerCase()}%`
+  }
+  if (filters.favoritesOnly) clauses.push('f.prompt_id IS NOT NULL')
+  if (filters.priceMode === 'free') clauses.push('p.price = 0')
+  if (filters.priceMode === 'paid') clauses.push('p.price > 0')
+
+  const order = {
+    featured: 'rank_score DESC, p.sold DESC',
+    newest: 'datetime(p.created_at) DESC',
+    popular: 'p.rating DESC, p.sold DESC',
+  }[filters.sort ?? 'featured']
+
+  return dbOrDefault(db)
+    .prepare(`
+      SELECT
+        p.id, p.slug, p.title, p.model, c.name AS category, p.price, p.sold, p.rating,
+        cr.name AS creator, p.aspect_ratio AS aspectRatio, p.description, p.image_url AS imageUrl,
+        CASE WHEN f.prompt_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isFavorite,
+        CASE WHEN ci.prompt_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS inCart,
+        ROUND((p.sold * 0.68) + (p.rating * 280) + CASE WHEN p.price = 0 THEN 320 ELSE 0 END, 2) AS rank_score
+      FROM prompts p
+      JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
+      JOIN creators cr ON cr.id = p.creator_id
+      LEFT JOIN favorites f ON f.prompt_id = p.id AND f.user_id = @userId
+      LEFT JOIN cart_items ci ON ci.prompt_id = p.id AND ci.user_id = @userId
+      WHERE ${clauses.join(' AND ')}
+      ORDER BY ${order}
+    `)
+    .all(params)
+    .map(toPromptCard)
+}
+
+export function getPrompt(slugOrId: string | number, db?: AppDb) {
+  const prompt = dbOrDefault(db)
+    .prepare(`
+      SELECT
+        p.id, p.slug, p.title, p.model, c.name AS category, p.price, p.sold, p.rating,
+        cr.name AS creator, p.aspect_ratio AS aspectRatio, p.description, p.image_url AS imageUrl,
+        CASE WHEN f.prompt_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isFavorite,
+        CASE WHEN ci.prompt_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS inCart,
+        ROUND((p.sold * 0.68) + (p.rating * 280) + CASE WHEN p.price = 0 THEN 320 ELSE 0 END, 2) AS rank_score
+      FROM prompts p
+      JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
+      JOIN creators cr ON cr.id = p.creator_id
+      LEFT JOIN favorites f ON f.prompt_id = p.id AND f.user_id = ?
+      LEFT JOIN cart_items ci ON ci.prompt_id = p.id AND ci.user_id = ?
+      WHERE p.slug = ? OR p.id = ?
+    `)
+    .get(userId, userId, String(slugOrId), Number(slugOrId) || -1) as Record<string, unknown> | undefined
+  return prompt ? toPromptCard(prompt) : undefined
+}
+
+export function getFilterCounts(db?: AppDb) {
+  return dbOrDefault(db).prepare(`
+    SELECT
+      SUM(CASE WHEN price = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS free,
+      SUM(CASE WHEN price > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid,
+      SUM(CASE WHEN sold >= 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS featured
+    FROM prompts
+  `).get() as { free: number; paid: number; featured: number }
+}
+
+export function toggleFavorite(promptId: number, db?: AppDb) {
+  const conn = dbOrDefault(db)
+  const existing = conn.prepare('SELECT 1 FROM favorites WHERE user_id = ? AND prompt_id = ?').get(userId, promptId)
+  if (existing) {
+    conn.prepare('DELETE FROM favorites WHERE user_id = ? AND prompt_id = ?').run(userId, promptId)
+    return false
+  }
+  conn.prepare('INSERT INTO favorites (user_id, prompt_id) VALUES (?, ?)').run(userId, promptId)
+  return true
+}
+
+export function addToCart(promptId: number, db?: AppDb) {
+  dbOrDefault(db).prepare('INSERT INTO cart_items (user_id, prompt_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, 1) ON CONFLICT(user_id, prompt_id) DO UPDATE SET quantity = 1').run(userId, promptId)
+  return getCart(db)
+}
+
+export function removeFromCart(promptId: number, db?: AppDb) {
+  dbOrDefault(db).prepare('DELETE FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = ? AND prompt_id = ?').run(userId, promptId)
+  return getCart(db)
+}
+
+export function getCart(db?: AppDb) {
+  const conn = dbOrDefault(db)
+  const items = conn.prepare(`
+    SELECT p.id, p.slug, p.title, p.model, c.name AS category, p.price, p.sold, p.rating,
+      cr.name AS creator, p.aspect_ratio AS aspectRatio, p.description, p.image_url AS imageUrl,
+      CASE WHEN f.prompt_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isFavorite,
+      1 AS inCart,
+      ROUND((p.sold * 0.68) + (p.rating * 280) + CASE WHEN p.price = 0 THEN 320 ELSE 0 END, 2) AS rank_score
+    FROM cart_items ci
+    JOIN prompts p ON p.id = ci.prompt_id
+    JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
+    JOIN creators cr ON cr.id = p.creator_id
+    LEFT JOIN favorites f ON f.prompt_id = p.id AND f.user_id = ci.user_id
+    WHERE ci.user_id = ?
+    ORDER BY p.title
+  `).all(userId).map(toPromptCard)
+
+  const totals = conn.prepare(`
+    SELECT
+      COALESCE(SUM(p.price * ci.quantity), 0) AS subtotal,
+      ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(p.price * ci.quantity), 0) * 0.08, 2) AS fees,
+      ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(p.price * ci.quantity), 0) * 1.08, 2) AS total,
+      COALESCE(SUM(ci.quantity), 0) AS itemCount
+    FROM cart_items ci
+    JOIN prompts p ON p.id = ci.prompt_id
+    WHERE ci.user_id = ?
+  `).get(userId) as CartTotals
+
+  return { items, totals }
+}
+
+export function checkout(db?: AppDb) {
+  const conn = dbOrDefault(db)
+  const cart = getCart(conn)
+  if (!cart.items.length) return { ok: false, orderId: null, cart }
+  const next = (conn.prepare('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1 AS id FROM orders').get() as { id: number }).id
+  const trx = conn.transaction(() => {
+    conn.prepare('INSERT INTO orders (id, user_id, created_at, subtotal, fees, total) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)').run(next, userId, new Date().toISOString(), cart.totals.subtotal, cart.totals.fees, cart.totals.total)
+    const insert = conn.prepare('INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, prompt_id, price, creator_id, category_id) SELECT ?, id, price, creator_id, category_id FROM prompts WHERE id = ?')
+    cart.items.forEach((item) => insert.run(next, item.id))
+    conn.prepare('DELETE FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = ?').run(userId)
+  })
+  trx()
+  return { ok: true, orderId: next, cart: getCart(conn) }
+}
+
+export function getAnalytics(db?: AppDb): AnalyticsSummary {
+  const conn = dbOrDefault(db)
+  const creatorRevenue = conn.prepare(`
+    SELECT cr.name AS creator, ROUND(SUM(oi.price * cr.commission_rate), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS sales,
+      ROUND((COUNT(*) * 1.0) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions), 0), 3) AS conversionRate,
+      ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id), 2) AS averageOrderValue
+    FROM order_items oi JOIN creators cr ON cr.id = oi.creator_id
+    GROUP BY cr.id ORDER BY revenue DESC
+  `).all() as AnalyticsSummary['creatorRevenue']
+  const categoryRevenue = conn.prepare(`
+    SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS sales
+    FROM order_items oi JOIN categories c ON c.id = oi.category_id
+    GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY revenue DESC
+  `).all() as AnalyticsSummary['categoryRevenue']
+  const dailySales = conn.prepare(`
+    SELECT substr(created_at, 1, 10) AS day, ROUND(SUM(total), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS orders
+    FROM orders GROUP BY substr(created_at, 1, 10) ORDER BY day
+  `).all() as AnalyticsSummary['dailySales']
+  const totals = conn.prepare(`
+    SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total), 0), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS orders,
+      ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions WHERE converted = 1) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions), 0), 3) AS conversionRate,
+      ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS averageOrderValue
+    FROM orders
+  `).get() as AnalyticsSummary['totals']
+  return { creatorRevenue, categoryRevenue, dailySales, totals }
+}
+
+function toPromptCard(row: Record<string, unknown>): PromptCard {
+  return {
+    id: Number(row.id),
+    slug: String(row.slug),
+    title: String(row.title),
+    model: row.model as PromptCard['model'],
+    category: String(row.category),
+    price: Number(row.price),
+    sold: Number(row.sold),
+    rating: Number(row.rating),
+    creator: String(row.creator),
+    aspectRatio: String(row.aspectRatio),
+    description: String(row.description),
+    imageUrl: String(row.imageUrl),
+    isFavorite: Boolean(row.isFavorite),
+    inCart: Boolean(row.inCart),
+    rankScore: Number(row.rank_score),
+  }
+}
*** End Patch

+  if (filters.model && filters.model !== 'all') {
+    clauses.push('p.model = @model')
+    params.model = filters.model
+  }
+  if (filters.category && filters.category !== 'all') {
+    clauses.push('c.name = @category')
+    params.category = filters.category
+  }
+  if (filters.term) {
+    clauses.push('(LOWER(p.title || " " || p.model || " " || c.name || " " || p.description) LIKE @term)')
+    params.term = `%${filters.term.toLowerCase()}%`
+  }
+  if (filters.favoritesOnly) clauses.push('f.prompt_id IS NOT NULL')
+  if (filters.priceMode === 'free') clauses.push('p.price = 0')
+  if (filters.priceMode === 'paid') clauses.push('p.price > 0')
+
+  const order = {
+    featured: 'rank_score DESC, p.sold DESC',
+    newest: 'datetime(p.created_at) DESC',
+    popular: 'p.rating DESC, p.sold DESC',
+  }[filters.sort ?? 'featured']
+
+  return dbOrDefault(db)
+    .prepare(`
+      SELECT
+        p.id, p.slug, p.title, p.model, c.name AS category, p.price, p.sold, p.rating,
+        cr.name AS creator, p.aspect_ratio AS aspectRatio, p.description, p.image_url AS imageUrl,
+        CASE WHEN f.prompt_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isFavorite,
+        CASE WHEN ci.prompt_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS inCart,
+        ROUND((p.sold * 0.68) + (p.rating * 280) + CASE WHEN p.price = 0 THEN 320 ELSE 0 END, 2) AS rank_score
+      FROM prompts p
+      JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
+      JOIN creators cr ON cr.id = p.creator_id
+      LEFT JOIN favorites f ON f.prompt_id = p.id AND f.user_id = @userId
+      LEFT JOIN cart_items ci ON ci.prompt_id = p.id AND ci.user_id = @userId
+      WHERE ${clauses.join(' AND ')}
+      ORDER BY ${order}
+    `)
+    .all(params)
+    .map(toPromptCard)
+}
+
+export function getPrompt(slugOrId: string | number, db?: AppDb) {
+  const prompt = dbOrDefault(db)
+    .prepare(`
+      SELECT
+        p.id, p.slug, p.title, p.model, c.name AS category, p.price, p.sold, p.rating,
+        cr.name AS creator, p.aspect_ratio AS aspectRatio, p.description, p.image_url AS imageUrl,
+        CASE WHEN f.prompt_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isFavorite,
+        CASE WHEN ci.prompt_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS inCart,
+        ROUND((p.sold * 0.68) + (p.rating * 280) + CASE WHEN p.price = 0 THEN 320 ELSE 0 END, 2) AS rank_score
+      FROM prompts p
+      JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
+      JOIN creators cr ON cr.id = p.creator_id
+      LEFT JOIN favorites f ON f.prompt_id = p.id AND f.user_id = ?
+      LEFT JOIN cart_items ci ON ci.prompt_id = p.id AND ci.user_id = ?
+      WHERE p.slug = ? OR p.id = ?
+    `)
+    .get(userId, userId, String(slugOrId), Number(slugOrId) || -1) as Record<string, unknown> | undefined
+  return prompt ? toPromptCard(prompt) : undefined
+}
+
+export function getFilterCounts(db?: AppDb) {
+  return dbOrDefault(db).prepare(`
+    SELECT
+      SUM(CASE WHEN price = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS free,
+      SUM(CASE WHEN price > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid,
+      SUM(CASE WHEN sold >= 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS featured
+    FROM prompts
+  `).get() as { free: number; paid: number; featured: number }
+}
+
+export function toggleFavorite(promptId: number, db?: AppDb) {
+  const conn = dbOrDefault(db)
+  const existing = conn.prepare('SELECT 1 FROM favorites WHERE user_id = ? AND prompt_id = ?').get(userId, promptId)
+  if (existing) {
+    conn.prepare('DELETE FROM favorites WHERE user_id = ? AND prompt_id = ?').run(userId, promptId)
+    return false
+  }
+  conn.prepare('INSERT INTO favorites (user_id, prompt_id) VALUES (?, ?)').run(userId, promptId)
+  return true
+}
+
+export function addToCart(promptId: number, db?: AppDb) {
+  dbOrDefault(db).prepare('INSERT INTO cart_items (user_id, prompt_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, 1) ON CONFLICT(user_id, prompt_id) DO UPDATE SET quantity = 1').run(userId, promptId)
+  return getCart(db)
+}
+
+export function removeFromCart(promptId: number, db?: AppDb) {
+  dbOrDefault(db).prepare('DELETE FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = ? AND prompt_id = ?').run(userId, promptId)
+  return getCart(db)
+}
+
+export function getCart(db?: AppDb) {
+  const conn = dbOrDefault(db)
+  const items = conn.prepare(`
+    SELECT p.id, p.slug, p.title, p.model, c.name AS category, p.price, p.sold, p.rating,
+      cr.name AS creator, p.aspect_ratio AS aspectRatio, p.description, p.image_url AS imageUrl,
+      CASE WHEN f.prompt_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isFavorite,
+      1 AS inCart,
+      ROUND((p.sold * 0.68) + (p.rating * 280) + CASE WHEN p.price = 0 THEN 320 ELSE 0 END, 2) AS rank_score
+    FROM cart_items ci
+    JOIN prompts p ON p.id = ci.prompt_id
+    JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
+    JOIN creators cr ON cr.id = p.creator_id
+    LEFT JOIN favorites f ON f.prompt_id = p.id AND f.user_id = ci.user_id
+    WHERE ci.user_id = ?
+    ORDER BY p.title
+  `).all(userId).map(toPromptCard)
+
+  const totals = conn.prepare(`
+    SELECT
+      COALESCE(SUM(p.price * ci.quantity), 0) AS subtotal,
+      ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(p.price * ci.quantity), 0) * 0.08, 2) AS fees,
+      ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(p.price * ci.quantity), 0) * 1.08, 2) AS total,
+      COALESCE(SUM(ci.quantity), 0) AS itemCount
+    FROM cart_items ci
+    JOIN prompts p ON p.id = ci.prompt_id
+    WHERE ci.user_id = ?
+  `).get(userId) as CartTotals
+
+  return { items, totals }
+}
+
+export function checkout(db?: AppDb) {
+  const conn = dbOrDefault(db)
+  const cart = getCart(conn)
+  if (!cart.items.length) return { ok: false, orderId: null, cart }
+  const next = (conn.prepare('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1 AS id FROM orders').get() as { id: number }).id
+  const trx = conn.transaction(() => {
+    conn.prepare('INSERT INTO orders (id, user_id, created_at, subtotal, fees, total) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)').run(next, userId, new Date().toISOString(), cart.totals.subtotal, cart.totals.fees, cart.totals.total)
+    const insert = conn.prepare('INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, prompt_id, price, creator_id, category_id) SELECT ?, id, price, creator_id, category_id FROM prompts WHERE id = ?')
+    cart.items.forEach((item) => insert.run(next, item.id))
+    conn.prepare('DELETE FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = ?').run(userId)
+  })
+  trx()
+  return { ok: true, orderId: next, cart: getCart(conn) }
+}
+
+export function getAnalytics(db?: AppDb): AnalyticsSummary {
+  const conn = dbOrDefault(db)
+  const creatorRevenue = conn.prepare(`
+    SELECT cr.name AS creator, ROUND(SUM(oi.price * cr.commission_rate), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS sales,
+      ROUND((COUNT(*) * 1.0) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions), 0), 3) AS conversionRate,
+      ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id), 2) AS averageOrderValue
+    FROM order_items oi JOIN creators cr ON cr.id = oi.creator_id
+    GROUP BY cr.id ORDER BY revenue DESC
+  `).all() as AnalyticsSummary['creatorRevenue']
+  const categoryRevenue = conn.prepare(`
+    SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS sales
+    FROM order_items oi JOIN categories c ON c.id = oi.category_id
+    GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY revenue DESC
+  `).all() as AnalyticsSummary['categoryRevenue']
+  const dailySales = conn.prepare(`
+    SELECT substr(created_at, 1, 10) AS day, ROUND(SUM(total), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS orders
+    FROM orders GROUP BY substr(created_at, 1, 10) ORDER BY day
+  `).all() as AnalyticsSummary['dailySales']
+  const totals = conn.prepare(`
+    SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total), 0), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS orders,
+      ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions WHERE converted = 1) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions), 0), 3) AS conversionRate,
+      ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS averageOrderValue
+    FROM orders
+  `).get() as AnalyticsSummary['totals']
+  return { creatorRevenue, categoryRevenue, dailySales, totals }
+}
+
+function toPromptCard(row: Record<string, unknown>): PromptCard {
+  return {
+    id: Number(row.id),
+    slug: String(row.slug),
+    title: String(row.title),
+    model: row.model as PromptCard['model'],
+    category: String(row.category),
+    price: Number(row.price),
+    sold: Number(row.sold),
+    rating: Number(row.rating),
+    creator: String(row.creator),
+    aspectRatio: String(row.aspectRatio),
+    description: String(row.description),
+    imageUrl: String(row.imageUrl),
+    isFavorite: Boolean(row.isFavorite),
+    inCart: Boolean(row.inCart),
+    rankScore: Number(row.rank_score),
+  }
+}
